follow-up time: Within 24 hours of birth (for primary outcome)
exposure: Women with diet or insulin-controlled GDM who presented with spontaneous clear PROM
finding: In women with GDM, a PROM-delivery time ≥18 hours was not associated with higher rates of neonatal hypoglycemia, but was associated with higher rates of chorioamnionitis and cesarean delivery.
mod_finding: Women with gestational diabetes and prolonged rupture of membranes were more likely to have cesarean deliveries.
